name: Jiangsu University of Science and Technology
supervisors: Jiangsu Provincial Government (co-built with SASTIND and with CSSC)

evidence.summary: JUST describes itself as co-built by the Jiangsu government separately with SASTIND and with the shipbuilding group CSSC.
It reports five national defence-specialty disciplines (国家国防特色学科).
JUST says it has taken a deep part in developing major national equipment for defence and naval modernisation, including aircraft carriers, large destroyers and nuclear submarines.
